tools.name: t1_protocol
tools.description: Translates ambiguous questions into T1 structured prompts. Output: L1 facts / L2 assumptions / L3 hypotheses / L4 unknowns / core question / output requirements. v2.5+: L3 evidence status, core link exemption.

weight_hint.description: Optional evaluation weight hint. English: fact-first, efficiency-first, cost-first, robustness-first, general-first. Chinese: 事实优先, 效率优先, 成本优先, 鲁棒性优先, 通用优先.

tools.name: t2_protocol
tools.description: Confidence evaluation for AI answers. Output: qualitative confidence (high/medium-high/medium/medium-low/low) + adoption recommendations. Run checksum before T2 when format integrity matters.

weight_hint.description: Optional evaluation weight hint (default: factual accuracy > efficiency). Same values as t1_protocol weight_hint.

tools.name: checksum
tools.description:
Deterministic structural pre-validation (semantic ECC Pre-T2 Checksum)
Input: AI answer text
Output: structural integrity assessment (pass/fail) + diagnostics
Zero LLM dependency - pure regex/string ops. Run before T2 to filter corrupted output.

text.description: The AI answer text to validate
